gloss: to hit, to strike; to be correct

definitions.explanation: To come into contact with something; to be hit by.
To be right; to win (a lottery, etc.).

examples.japanese: ボールが{頭|あたま}に{当|あ}たった。
{宝|たから}くじが{当|あ}たった！

notes:
{当|あ}たる has multiple meanings.

KEY USES:
1. TO HIT: 〜に{当|あ}たる (to hit against ~)
2. TO WIN: くじに{当|あ}たる (to win lottery)
3. TO BE CORRECT: {予想|よそう}が{当|あ}たる
4. TO APPLY TO: 〜に{当|あ}たる (to correspond to)

RELATED:
- {当|あ}てる (v.t.): to hit (something)
- {当|あ}たり: hit, success
- {当|あ}たり{前|まえ}: natural, obvious
